description: Disposable Hyper-V test VMs from a pool, Windows or Linux (Debian, Ubuntu): several agents at once, from a clean or shared checkpoint or kept warm; lease checkpoints; session 0, desktop or SSH runs.

apps: Its helper service, set up once in an admin terminal (setup\install.cmd), and again after upgrading

For Windows VMs, one of: a Windows x64 ISO of your choice (for example Microsoft's Windows 11 Enterprise evaluation, or your own copy with its product key), downloaded yourself (the helper downloads nothing); or a ready-made, not sysprepped Windows .vhdx or one of your own VMs, with its admin account's password, typed when you approve
For Linux guests only: Windows' OpenSSH Client (an optional feature), and a qcow2 cloud image of your choice (Debian 13 and Ubuntu 26.04 have been run)
